assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: Portrait scene illustration, 1024x1536, for the fantasy encyclopedia Aleria Almanach entry 'Das Arkane Alphabet'.
Primary request: A learned druid and an adult apprentice study the ancient ritual alphabet at an oak desk in a medieval stone library. The druid in dark forest-green robes calmly guides the apprentice's quill over an aged parchment, a small restrained amber magical glow rises from an engraved talisman. Shelves of leather books, brass tools, candles, and cool daylight through a leaded window.
Style/medium: Refined hand-drawn fantasy anime illustration, clean delicate dark outlines, natural adult proportions, detailed faces and hands, restrained cel shading, painterly stone and wood textures. Match the existing Almanach scene artwork, scholarly and intimate rather than heroic action.
Composition/framing: Vertical three-quarter view, two people and their working hands clearly visible, desk with parchment and an open folio in foreground, no cropping of heads.
Color palette: Parchment cream, warm oak brown, desaturated forest green, muted gold, cool slate shadows.
Materials/textures: Worn leather, brass, linen, vellum. A few curved spiral and eye-shaped ritual glyphs with pointed tips on the parchment, as decorative markings only.
Constraints: No readable words, no title, no border, no watermark, no modern items, no neon, no giant floating symbols.
